thread:
alex: quick post-AH recap + a few clarifying asks from the roadmap Q&A. Thanks for the great questions. I'll keep this focused: three follow-ups (evals, private deploy timeline, pricing/estimates). links and owners below. :clipboard:
nina: timeline for public eval harness? is the plan still 'early aug' for internal, sept for public?
alex: yes 1) internal eval harness by 2026-08-10, 2) limited external preview w/ partners 2026-08-24, 3) public console integration 2026-09-20.
priyam: infra note  we need an S3-backed storage tier for private evals (customer uploads) plus role ACLs. estimating infra work ~3 wks.
nina: owner for eval docs/UI? want a minimal how-to and schema example in the console.
tom: I'll draft the customer-facing how-to and sample schema (owner: tom), due 2026-08-05. Nina will review.
notabot: task created: "eval-harness-infra" due 2026-07-28, notify: #eng-ml, #eng-infra.
alex: private deployment ask  a few customers asked if Private can support on-prem air-gapped in GA. short answer?
priyam: GA will support VPC and managed private control plane. Air-gapped on-prem is post-GA (planning Q4). We'll document the roadmap clearly.
nina: pricing/estimates: product wanted a small calc for Dedicated vs Hosted for sales decks. Who owns a quick estimator?
tom: marketing + finance will own a one-page estimator. I'll draft a spreadsheet and a short copy. target 2026-07-25.
priyam: engineering follow-up  we need a compatibility checklist for customers migrating models (token format, session semantics). I'll put a checklist PR in the runtime repo. owner: priyam, due 2026-07-10.
alex: consolidated actions (short): 1) infra for private evals (priyam) - 2026-07-28; 2) eval how-to + schema (tom) - 2026-08-05; 3) runtime migration checklist (priyam) - 2026-07-10; 4) pricing estimator one-pager (tom + finance) - 2026-07-25; 5) public eval console integration (nina + devex) - 2026-09-20.
nina: I'll open follow-up threads in #eng-ml and #product to carry the details. ping me if you want to be an owner. :rocket:
alex: thanks all 1 I'll keep this thread as the high-level log and move technical details to the respective channels. RFC link: https://redwood.example.com/rfc/ah-synthesis-2026.
